title: 4lwayz/portwatch-vi
why_read: This is a tracker website for community reverse-engineering progress, not a technical project itself — it has minimal engineering interest on its own.
analysis: The project appears to be a live status dashboard built in JavaScript that monitors and reports on community efforts to run GTA VI on PC. The engineering value of the tracker itself is low; building a daily-updated status page is a routine web task. Its value is entirely dependent on the accuracy and freshness of the information it aggregates. As a tool for following the VIctory and similar projects, it is useful context but not independently interesting.
